21404-from-powder-monkey-to-admiral-a-st.creator: Unknown
21404-from-powder-monkey-to-admiral-a-st.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. When the _Boys' Own Paper_ was first started, Mr Kingston, who showed deep interest in the project, undertook to write a story of the sea, during the wars, under the title of "From Powder-monkey to Admiral."

2517-lincoln-s-yarns-and-stories.title: Lincoln S Yarns And Stories
2517-lincoln-s-yarns-and-stories.creator: Alexander K. McClure
2517-lincoln-s-yarns-and-stories.description: A book by Alexander K. McClure. Aesop’s Fables have been printed in book form in almost every language and millions have read them with pleasure and profit. Lincoln’s stories were scattered in the recollections of thousands of people in various parts of the country. The historians who wrote histories of Lincoln’s life remembered only a few of them, but the most of Lincoln’s stories and the best of them remained unwritten.

arxiv-1707-02367.title: Monotonicity of saddle maps
arxiv-1707-02367.creator: Anton Petrunin and Stephan Stadler
arxiv-1707-02367.description: Abstract We prove an analog of the Schoen–Yau univalentness theorem for saddle maps between discs. † † footnotetext: A. Petrunin was partially supported by NSF grant DMS 1309340. S. Stadler was supported by DFG grants STA 1511/1-1 and SPP 2026.

arxiv-2011-06931.title: The Anytime-Valid Logrank Test: Error Control Under Continuous Monitoring with Unlimited Horizon Volume: 0 Issue: 0 Publication type: research-article DOI: 0000
arxiv-2011-06931.creator: J. Judith ter Schure c1 label=e1]j.a.terschure@amsterdamumc.nl, M.F. Muriel F. Pérez-Ortiz c1 label=e2]muriel.perez@cwi.nl, A. Alexander Ly label=e3]a.ly@cwi.nl, P.D. Peter D. Grünwald label=e4]pdg@cwi.nl
arxiv-2011-06931.description: Abstract We introduce the anytime-valid (AV) logrank test, a version of the logrank test that provides type-I error guarantees under optional stopping and optional continuation. The test is sequential without the need to specify a maximum sample size or stopping rule, and allows for cumulative meta-analysis with type-I error control. The method can be extended to define anytime-valid confidence intervals.

arxiv-2203-02598.title: Attraction Between Electron Pairs in High Temperature Superconductors
arxiv-2203-02598.creator: Phil Attard
arxiv-2203-02598.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Phil Attard. It is proposed that in high temperature superconductors Cooper pairs form and condense due to the monotonic-oscillatory transition in the pair potential of mean force, which occurs quite generally at high coupling in charge systems. It is shown that the predicted transition temperatures are broadly in line with measured superconducting transition temperatures for reasonable values of the total electron density and the residual dielectric permittivity arising from the immobile electrons. The predicted transition is independent of the isotopic masses of the solid.

arxiv-2203-10210.title: Coordinated Pose Control of Mobile Manipulation with an Unstable Bikebot Platform Thanks: This work was partially supported by the US National Science Foundation under award CNS-1932370.
arxiv-2203-10210.creator: Feng Han, Alborz Jelvani, Jingang Yi, Tao Liu
arxiv-2203-10210.description: Abstract Bikebot manipulation has advantages of the single-track robot mobility and manipulation dexterity. We present a coordinated pose control of mobile manipulation with the stationary bikebot. The challenges of the bikebot manipulation include the limited steering balance capability of the unstable bikebot and kinematic redundancy of the manipulator.

arxiv-2303-11436.title: Mind meets machine: Unravelling GPT-4’s cognitive psychology
arxiv-2303-11436.creator: Sifatkaur Dhingra, Manmeet Singh, Vaisakh SB, Neetiraj Malviya, Sukhpal Singh Gill
arxiv-2303-11436.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sifatkaur Dhingra, Manmeet Singh, Vaisakh SB, Neetiraj Malviya, Sukhpal Singh Gill. Cognitive psychology delves on understanding perception, attention, memory, language, problem-solving, decision-making, and reasoning. Large language models (LLMs) are emerging as potent tools increasingly capable of performing human-level tasks. The recent development in the form of GPT-4 and its demonstrated success in tasks complex to humans exam and complex problems has led to an increased confidence in the LLMs to become perfect instruments of intelligence.

arxiv-2404-14383.title: Observational characterisation of large-scale transport and horizontal turbulent diffusivity in the quiet Sun
arxiv-2404-14383.creator: F. Rincon, P. Barrère, T. Roudier
arxiv-2404-14383.description: Abstract The Sun is a magnetic star, and the only spatio-temporally resolved astrophysical system displaying turbulent magnetohydrodynamic thermal convection. This makes it a privileged object of study to understand fluid turbulence in extreme regimes and its interactions with magnetic fields.

arxiv-2501-08373.title: Theory of the Photomolecular Effect
arxiv-2501-08373.creator: Michael J. Landry, Chuliang Fu, James H. Zhang, Jiachen Li, Gang Chen, Mingda Li
arxiv-2501-08373.description: Abstract It is well-known that water in both liquid and vapor phases exhibits exceptionally weak absorption of light in the visible range. Recent experiments, however, have demonstrated that at the liquid-air interface, absorption in the visible range is drastically increased.

arxiv-2506-15435.title: Fast Learning of Optimal Policy Trees
arxiv-2506-15435.creator: James Cussens, Julia Hatamyar, Vishalie Shah, Noemi Kreif
arxiv-2506-15435.description: Abstract We develop and implement a version of the popular policytree method (Athey and Wager, 2021) using discrete optimisation techniques. We test the performance of our algorithm in finite samples and find an improvement in the runtime of policytree learning by a factor of nearly 50 compared to the original version.

arxiv-2507-18165.title: ProactiveVA: Proactive Visual Analytics with LLM-Based UI Agent
arxiv-2507-18165.creator: \authororcid Yuheng Zhao0000-0003-1573-8772, \authororcid Xueli Shu0009-0003-5058-0541, \authororcid Liwen Fan0009-0007-3568-1271, \authororcid Lin Gao0009-0004-1613-1774, \authororcid Yu Zhang0000-0002-9035-0463, \authororcid Siming Chen0000-0002-2690-3588
arxiv-2507-18165.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by \authororcid Yuheng Zhao0000-0003-1573-8772, \authororcid Xueli Shu0009-0003-5058-0541, \authororcid Liwen Fan0009-0007-3568-1271, \authororcid Lin Gao0009-0004-1613-1774, \authororcid Yu Zhang0000-0002-9035-0463, \authororcid Siming Chen0000-0002-2690-3588. Visual analytics (VA) is typically applied to complex data, thus requiring complex tools. While visual analytics empowers analysts in data analysis, analysts may get lost in the complexity occasionally. This highlights the need for intelligent assistance mechanisms. However, even the latest LLM-assisted VA systems only provide help when explicitly requested by the user, making them insufficiently intelligent to offer suggestions when analysts need them the most.

arxiv-2507-22528.title: Supersymmetric Schur polynomials have saturated Newton polytopes
arxiv-2507-22528.creator: Dang Tuan Hiep, Khai-Hoan Nguyen-Dang
arxiv-2507-22528.description: Abstract . We prove that every supersymmetric Schur polynomial has a saturated Newton polytope (SNP). Our approach begins with a tableau-theoretic description of the support, which we encode as a polyhedron with a totally unimodular constraint matrix. The integrality of this polyhedron follows from the Hoffman–Kruskal criterion, thereby establishing the SNP property.

Watson, Ayan Acharyya, Jacob Levine, Benedetta Vulcani, Alexandra Le Reste, Farhanul Hasan, James Colbert, Michele Trenti, Xin Wang, Matthew A. Malkan, Andrew J. Bunker, Anah
arxiv-2601-02220.description: Abstract We present the Parallel Application of Slitless Spectroscopy to Analyze Galaxy Evolution (PASSAGE) spectroscopic redshift catalog in the COSMOS field. PASSAGE is a JWST Cycle 1 Near Infrared Imager and Slitless Spectrograph (NIRISS) wide-field slitless spectroscopy (WFSS) pure-parallel survey, obtaining near-infrared spectra of thousands of extragalactic sources.

plos-pone-0008122.creator: Yongsoo Kim, Isabelle Comte, Gabor Szabo et al.
plos-pone-0008122.description: PLOS ONE research article. The adult subventricular zone (SVZ) contains stem and progenitor cells that generate neuroblasts throughout life. Although it is well accepted that SVZ neuroblasts are migratory, recent evidence suggests their progenitor cells may also exhibit motility. Since stem and progenitor

pmc-10537703.title: Construction of Metal Organic Framework-Derived Fe-N-C Oxidase Nanozyme for Rapid and Sensitive Detection of Alkaline Phosphatase
pmc-10537703.creator: Mengmeng Pan, Ming Wang, Linjiao Yang, Yongli Song, Ming Jiang, Xu Yu, Li Xu, Daniela Iannazzo
pmc-10537703.description: Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) is a phosphomonoester hydrolase and serves as a biomarker in various diseases. However, current detection methods for ALP rely on bulky instruments, extended time, and complex operations, which are particularly challenging in resource-limited regions. Herein, we synthesized a MOF-derived Fe-N-C nanozyme to create biosensors for the coulometric and visual detection of ALP.

pmc-11351227.title: Macrogenomics Reveals Effects on Marine Microbial Communities during Oplegnathus punctatus Enclosure Farming
pmc-11351227.creator: Lijun Wang, Xiaofei Lu, Zhikai Xing, Xindong Teng, Shuang Wang, Tianyi Liu, Li Zheng, Xumin Wang, Jiangyong Qu
pmc-11351227.description: Simple SummaryThe water environment in Laizhou Bay has experienced mild eutrophication in recent years, impacting the interactions between environmental factors, microorganisms, and aquatic species. The metagenomic analysis of 142 samples from various water layers revealed that Oplegnathus punctatus mariculture significantly increases microbial abundance and complexity in the culture area. These alterations were more noticeable in sediments compared to seawater.

pmc-11387112.title: Bioelectrical impedance vector analysis and track and field jump performance across different specialties: Sex differences and electrode configuration
pmc-11387112.creator: Álex Cebrián‐Ponce, Matteo Levi Micheli, Claudia Politi, Eva Bianchi, Marta Carrasco‐Marginet, Pascal Izzicupo, Gabriele Mascherini
pmc-11387112.description: The assessment of athletic performance using non‐invasive methods has been a significant focus in research aimed at measuring physiological parameters. This study explores the application of bioelectrical impedance vector analysis (BIVA) among track and field athletes, with a focus on sex differences, electrode configuration, and the correlation between BIVA parameters and jump performances.

pmc-12391361.title: Predictive analysis of concrete tensile strength using metaheuristic algorithms helping a neural network
pmc-12391361.creator: Xun Dong
pmc-12391361.description: In most construction projects, concrete is a widely used material in different structural elements due to its suitable mechanical behavior. Therefore, it is crucial to achieve a dependable estimation of the concrete mechanical parameters such as tensile strength. In this research, a well-known machine learning model—multi-layer perceptron neural network (MLPNN)—is optimized by multi-tracker optimization algorithm (MTOA) to avoid computational insufficiencies.

pmc-12469459.title: Birth–Death Dynamics of Microsatellites: Mechanistic Insights from Orthologous Loci in Felidae
pmc-12469459.creator: Wenping Zhang, Mingchun Zhang, Hao Liu, Miloš Macholán
pmc-12469459.description: Background/Objectives: The mutational dynamics of microsatellites over deep evolutionary timescales are poorly understood. This study aims to elucidate the life history of trinucleotide microsatellites by tracing orthologous loci across divergent vertebrate lineages and characterizing their mutational pathways. Methods: We developed a bioinformatic framework for identifying orthologous microsatellite loci using conserved flanking sequences.

pmc-12562170.title: Resveratrol and Its Nitric Oxide–Donor Hybrid as an Emerging Therapy for Oxidative-Stress-Driven Priapism in Sickle Cell Disease
pmc-12562170.creator: Carolina Oliveira Splendore, Mariana G de Oliveira, Fernando Ferreira Costa, Fábio Henrique Silva, Robert John Aitken, Joel R Drevet, Geoffry De Iuliis, Zamira Gibb
pmc-12562170.description: Priapism is a frequent and debilitating complication in patients with sickle cell disease (SCD), characterized by recurrent ischemic episodes that can culminate in fibrosis of the erectile tissue and irreversible erectile dysfunction. Despite significant advancements in the management of acute episodes, current therapies remain largely ineffective in preventing recurrences, emphasizing the need for novel strategies that target the underlying pathophysiology.

pmc-12764857.title: Responses to active stand test predict 12-year incident cardiovascular disease and mortality
pmc-12764857.creator: Belinda Hernández, Adam H Dyer, Cathal McCrory, Louise Newman, Mark Ward, Ciaran Finucane, Rose Anne Kenny
pmc-12764857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAn integrated haemodynamic response during standing may serve as a marker of neuro-cardiovascular function. Individual components of both heart rate (HR) and blood pressure (BP) responses to active stand (AS) have been linked with cardiovascular disease (CVD) and mortality. We hypothesised that integrating BP/HR information from the entire haemodynamic response curve may uncover otherwise unknown associations with both CVD and mortality.MethodsBeat-to-beat measurements of dynamic HR/BP responses to AS were conducted in 4336 individuals (61.5 ± 8.2 years; 53.7% female).

pmc-12830930.title: Noncanonical role of astrocytic mitochondrial Cx43: suppressing IDH3α to sustain glycolytic homeostasis against depression
pmc-12830930.creator: Junrui Ye, Hongyun Wang, Ye Peng, Shasha Wang, Ruifang Zheng, Yuqi Chen, Ruolan Yuan, Zhenzhen Wang, Xu Yan, Wenbin He, Gang Li, Hongshuo Sun, Zhongping Feng, Shifeng Chu, Zhao Zhang, Naihong Chen
pmc-12830930.description: Depression remains a pervasive global health challenge, compounded by limited therapeutic efficacy that is partly attributed to incompletely understood metabolic underpinnings. In this study, we reveal a noncanonical mitochondrial function of astrocytic connexin 43 (Cx43) whereby it directly inhibits isocitrate dehydrogenase 3α (IDH3α), thereby sustaining glycolytic metabolism and lactate production essential for neuronal excitability.

pmc-12917879.title: Addressing the implementation challenge of risk prediction model due to missing risk factors: The submodel approximation approach
pmc-12917879.creator: Tianyi Sun, Allison B. McCoy, Alan B. Storrow, Dandan Liu
pmc-12917879.description: Clinical prediction models have been widely acknowledged as informative tools providing evidence-based support for clinical decision making. However, prediction models are often underused in clinical practice due to many reasons including missing information upon real-time risk calculation in electronic health records (EHR) system.

pmc-12969687.title: XN@CuO/HA nanobipyramids trigger FOXO1-GADD45G-mediated cuproptosis and synergy with anti-PD-1 for lung cancer therapy
pmc-12969687.creator: Ruiyang Jiang, Xiangming Huang, Yiran Ouyang, Bichong Luo, HongYang Wan, Fangyang Shou, Xiahui Wu, Junting Fan, Jingyuan Zhang, Dongdong Sun, Changliang Xu, Zhijun Fang
pmc-12969687.description: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with current therapies limited by drug resistance and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Cuproptosis offers new therapeutic prospects, but effective induction and targeted delivery remain challenging. Herein, we developed xanthohumol (XN)-coordinated copper oxide/hyaluronic acid (XN@CuO/HA) nanobipyramids as a novel cuproptosis inducer for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) therapy.

pmc-12994311.title: Anti‐Müllerian Hormone as a Marker for Castration Status and Fertility in Bulls and Oxen
pmc-12994311.creator: Doreena Gilg, Christiane Otzdorff, Yury Zablotski, Holm Zerbe, Beate Walter
pmc-12994311.description: Anti‐Müllerian hormone (AMH) has been established as an indicator of castration status and fertility in several species. However, its applicability in postpubertal bulls and oxen has not yet been thoroughly investigated. This study examined 73 bulls aged between 12 and 107 months and 37 oxen older than 12 months.

pmc-13220161.title: Decoding Solvent Effects in Electrocatalytic Biomass Valorization: Levulinic Acid to γ‑Valerolactone
pmc-13220161.creator: Pol Vilariño, Queralt Bautista, Elvira Gómez, Albert Serrà
pmc-13220161.description: Electrocatalytic hydrogenation (ECH) of biomass-derived levulinic acid (LA) offers a sustainable route to prepare γ-valerolactone (GVL), a versatile green solvent and fuel additive. Yet despite its promise, most studies overlook the decisive role of the solvent environment, conflating conversion with true product yield.

pmc-13303345.title: Use of Honey/Gotu Kola/κ-Carrageenan Base Hydrogel Film Dressing on Diabetic Foot Ulcer Patient in Home Care Setting: a case report
pmc-13303345.creator: Sari Meisyayati, Amirah Adlia, Aluicia Anita Artarini, I Ketut Adnyana
pmc-13303345.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Effective management of early diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) is essential for reducing the risks of amputation and mortality. Affordable wound dressings are particularly important for low-income patients because wound healing often requires prolonged treatment. This case report describes the effects of a combined intervention on wound status and quality of life in a 54-year-old woman with a Grade 2 DFU located on the right heel.

pmc-13361796.title: Quality Deterioration Kinetics and Arrhenius-Based Shelf-Life Prediction of Ready-to-Eat Tremella fuciformis Cold Dishes
pmc-13361796.creator: Rucai Chen, Wei Deng, Zhipeng Zheng, Yibin Li

pmc-13369305.title: Fluid-induced acid–base variations in postoperative critically ill patients: physiological determinants and renal response
pmc-13369305.creator: Francesco Zadek, Luca Zazzeron, Michele Ferrari, Davide Ottolina, Matteo Nafi, Floriana Ferrari, Eleonora Scotti, Federica Vagginelli, Marco Lattuada, Micah Liam Arthur Heldeweg, Lorenzo Giosa, Martin Krbec, Thomas Langer, Pietro Caironi
pmc-13369305.description: BackgroundAlterations of acid–base balance induced by intravenous fluids are primarily related to changes in plasma strong ion difference (SIDPL) and nonvolatile weak acids. Previous studies suggest that the relationship between the SID of infused fluids (SIDINF) and pre-infusion plasma bicarbonate (HCO3−) may act as an integrative factor influencing acid–base changes during fluid replacement.

pmc-13443843.title: A federated deep learning framework with distributed hybrid character-level and attention mechanisms for scalable and cost-efficient fake news detection
pmc-13443843.creator: K Nithya, C R Dhivyaa
pmc-13443843.description: Fake news detection is an essential task for media and news organizations to maintain the trust and reliability of the published content. Due to the rapid growth of online users and the spread of misinformation through malicious sources, the fake news circulates quickly across digital platforms.
